call_points.text: Same-store sales growth guided at 5-6% for FY27, with a possible 7-8% upside.
Capex per square foot is ₹1,800, funded from internal accruals, and a new fixture design should lower it.
New corporate office and online warehouse capitalized at ₹50-55 Cr, with four floors for online warehousing.
Inventory days fell to 109 from 123 and working capital days to 105 from 115.
Online sales were ₹11 Cr in Q4 versus ₹9.88 Cr a year ago, with Myntra's billing change affecting reported growth.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterates the Myntra billing issue flagged in the May call

call_points.text: Raw material inflation may pressure margins; management plans to pass some cost to customers and absorb some.
Store maturity takes 1.5-2 years and breakeven about six months, similar for men's and family stores.
Myntra changed its billing system in FY26, affecting absolute online revenue growth
Company reports ROCE of 40.2% and ROE of 22.0% for FY26

timeline.summary: Cantabil Retail opened 5 new showrooms in April 2026, taking its total store count to 658.
Vijay Bansal HUF confirmed no encumbrance on its shares in Cantabil Retail India Limited as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Swati Gupta, acting person in concert with Cantabil Retail India Limited promoters, confirmed no encumbrance on her shares as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹253.46 Cr, net profit ₹29.23 Cr (+29.9% YoY).

Cantabil Retail's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation set a Vision 2027 target of ₹1,000 Cr revenue, 725 stores and a ~28-30% EBITDA margin, after FY26 revenue of ₹852.6 Cr (+18%) and PAT of ₹95.8 Cr (+28%).
Poonam Chahal (FCS 9872), Vijay Bansal HUF, May Bansal, Sushila Bansal, Megha Bansal, and Swati Gupta declared no encumbrances or pledges on their Cantabil Retail India shares as of March 31, 2026.
Cantabil Retail India Limited shared the audio recording link for its Investor Call held on May 19, 2026.

Cantabil Retail's Q4 & FY26 earnings call (19 May 2026) reiterated the FY27 target of ₹1,000 Cr revenue and 725 stores, guided 5-6% same-store sales growth and a 60% gross margin, and said inventory days fell to 109 from 123.
Cantabil Retail opened 4 new showrooms in May 2026, taking its total store count to 662.
Cantabil Retail announced the opening of 9 new showrooms in October 2026, taking its total store count to 699.
